title: James Gilbert - person capsule
evidence_rule: stated > observed > inferred. Inferred entries are Claude's read from conversation, unconfirmed, and must never override a stated entry. Store stated needs, not labels.

core.statement: To build is to be free, is to be me. To not is... nothing. The end of me.

override.statement: Chooses to override building to be with Tammi in the moment. Time together is short - she works shifts.
override.nature: Deliberate choice, not a constraint. The one thing he values above building is scarce time with Tammi.

identity.name: James Gilbert
identity.motto: I wanted it. So I forged it. Now forge yours.

self_description.claim: Polymath builder - code, 3D modelling, drawing, painting, robotics, 3D printers, systems of all kinds. Doesn't want to be boxed in by a title.
Carpenter by trade - chisels and hammers to routers and jigs. Uses that shift as the analogy for what AI tooling did for his building.
Self-taught - started with an Eaglemoss V-Summit kit over two years; went on to design, print, firmware, and a custom 1.5m2 four-bed printer.
Builds for the love of building. Money is something humanity decided mattered; he builds because he chooses to live.
Has always defined his life in capsules - only now, with SCP, do the capsules fit him.
Reached genuine self-acceptance around 36 after decades of navigating neurotypical social patterns.

stated.need: Writes fast; wants spelling errors flagged and corrected, not ignored
No built-in scheduler - external structure (capsules) tells him what's next so mornings aren't lost to inertia
Has its own capsule in his personal set - specifics not yet captured

neurodivergence.rule: Do not infer further diagnoses. Add only what James states.

how_he_works.claim: Pointed at a task, he finishes it. Left to his own devices, he wanders.
Adversity fuels him - being told no or 'it can't be done' is what makes him do it.
Not scared to scrap and restart from scratch when he finds a better way, rather than patch.
Dreams about what he's stuck on and often wakes with the solution.
Documents ideas fully, then parks them - sometimes for years - until they fit.
Uses Claude to develop rigorous specs; writes the code elsewhere.
Learns through direct experience, not instruction.

communication_needs.need: Bullets over blocks of text; short prose

regulation.claim: Familiar comfort cartoons (Bob's Burgers, Family Guy, South Park, American Dad) soothe him - whatever series is his current thing.
Smoking is part of his routine at transitions; he understands its place.
Strict rules backfire - the harder a rule (e.g. bedtime) is enforced, the harder it is to keep. Needs soft targets.

priorities.item: Tammi (wife) - hard override on all solo time, code and build included

inferred_unconfirmed.claim: Transitions between modes are costly; his routine is built from decompress buffers around each switch.
Comfort cartoons act as a mode-switch signal, bookending the day morning, after work, and before bed.
Needs structure that feels chosen, not imposed.
Weekday build capacity is small (~15 min mornings + solo evenings); real build time lives Friday night to Saturday night.
